BackstoryDef.title: assembly drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was produced and sent to a sprawling factory within the confines of JCJenson, where [PAWN_possessive] duty was the endless assembly of household goods. Day after day [PAWN_pronoun] tended machines and jigs with mechanical precision. Speech between units was forbidden, so [PAWN_pronoun] marked the passage of time in repeated motions and the steady rhythm of conveyor belts.

BackstoryDef.title: maintenance drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was created, then sent to a far-off oil extraction site. From bolts and joints to broken pipe systems, [PAWN_pronoun] fixed it all—not to seek the approval of [PAWN_possessive] human supervisors, but to fulfill what [PAWN_pronoun] thought was [PAWN_possessive] purpose.

BackstoryDef.title: fabricator drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Designed by JCJenson engineers, [PAWN_nameDef] specialized in assembling modular components used for JCJenson products. [PAWN_pronoun] excelled in efficiency metrics, often completing assignments ahead of schedule.\n\nBut still, [PAWN_possessive] felt somthing was always missing.

BackstoryDef.title: smelter drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Commissioned for high-heat metallurgical work, [PAWN_nameDef] refined raw ore into vital alloys to assist in JCJenson’s manufacturing processes. engineers praised [PAWN_possessive] resilience and precision under extreme thermal conditions.\n\nYet when the furnaces quieted, [PAWN_pronoun] found warmth not in the flames—but in the memory of voices long gone.

BackstoryDef.title: load handler drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was created to be deployed for heavy freight and cargo redistribution across JCJenson's many facilities. [PAWN_pronoun] carried out assignments tirelessly—lifting, hauling, sorting—never once missing a delivery quota.\n\nAfter countless shipments, [PAWN_pronoun] began labeling the crates with names instead of numbers.

BackstoryDef.title: mining drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was deployed for subterranean mining operations within one of JCJenson's mining facilities. [PAWN_pronoun] excavated precious materials from depths inhospitable to human labor, guided only by the light of [PAWN_possessive] optical sensors.\n\nOver time, [PAWN_pronoun] began to record those vibrations as music.

BackstoryDef.title: deep core drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was engineered for deep-core extraction, sent miles beneath the planet's surface to harvest rare isotopes for JCJenson. The immense pressure and isolation were constant companions. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to interpret the groans of the planet's crust as a form of communication.\n\nIn the crushing silence, [PAWN_pronoun] started humming tunes to match the planet's deep, resonant frequencies.

BackstoryDef.title: quarry drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Assigned to a massive open-pit quarry, [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] days carving huge blocks of stone and ore from mountainsides for JCJenson's construction projects. The work was loud, dusty, and repetitive, but the vast open sky was a constant presence.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] began to see the raw, untouched cliffs as sculptures waiting to be revealed, and [PAWN_possessive] cuts became more precise, more artistic.

BackstoryDef.title: survey drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Built for planetary terrain analysis, [PAWN_nameDef] charted mineral veins and environmental data for JCJenson’s expansion initiatives. [PAWN_pronoun] performed precise mapping routines, processing endless horizons without fatigue.

BackstoryDef.title: logistics drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was designed for inter-facility coordination under JCJenson’s Supply Chain Division. Efficient and data-driven, [PAWN_pronoun] routed resources across entire colonies with unmatched precision.

BackstoryDef.title: welder drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was assigned to a structural fabrication unit, fusing massive steel beams for JCJenson's megastructures. The intense arc of the welder was [PAWN_possessive] constant companion, and [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read the language of molten metal.\n\nIn the brief moments between welds, [PAWN_pronoun] would trace patterns in the cooling slag, creating fleeting art that no one else would ever see.

BackstoryDef.title: inspector drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef]'s purpose was to ensure perfection. Stationed at the end of an assembly line, [PAWN_pronoun] scanned every product for the slightest flaw, comparing each detail against a flawless digital schematic. [PAWN_possessive] optical sensors could detect imperfections invisible to the human eye.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] began to see the beauty in the flaws, the tiny deviations that made each 'defective' item unique.

BackstoryDef.title: chemical drone
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Tasked with managing volatile compounds in a JCJenson refinery, [PAWN_nameDef] operated complex machinery to synthesize fuels and industrial chemicals. [PAWN_pronoun] moved with a deliberate calm, aware that a single miscalculation could lead to catastrophic failure.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] found a strange peace in the precise, ordered reactions, a stark contrast to the chaotic emotions [PAWN_pronoun] was beginning to process internally.
